versions.notes: Waveshare UPS HAT (E) (4 x 21700, for the Pi 5): found by itself at I2C 0x2D - charge level, time left and charging from its battery chip, the 4 cell voltages, USB-C input; power cut / back and safe shutdown as before. The «Listen» quick switch lights up green while listening (it never did).

when Motion Watch starts in the background (autostart), a small message appears on the Pi's desktop with the address of the page (waits for the desktop after booting; can be switched off under Setup).

the guide (all five languages) describes the new parts: sensors, storm warning, GPS, solar, turning the picture, mask and talk tiles, lens check, announcements, animal species, PDF report, users, hardware check.

animal species (AI detection): a second AI model (ONNX, e.g. for fox, badger, wild boar, marten, deer) looks at every animal the first AI finds; the species appears on the picture, in the log and in the diary. The model is not included - it is installed from an address (URL) or copied into the models folder.

hardware check step by step (System → Help and setup): camera, movement, AI, thermal camera, servos, microphone, loudspeaker, lights, push message and every extra sensor - each step checks itself where it can.

several users (System → Users): own login per person with a role - «Operate» (arm / disarm, lights, camera, talk; no settings) or «View only». The web password stays the administrator. The log shows who did what.

solar panel (Sensors): an INA219 current meter shows watts, volts and today's yield; night forecast - does the battery last until sunrise? (self-check, and a push message in the evening when it will not).
announcement from text (Loudspeaker): the Pi speaks a typed text, offline (pico2wave or espeak-ng); it can be saved as an own sound and then used for the siren / deterrence.
event report as PDF (recordings: 📄): pictures, time, place with map link, device, the log around the event and a checksum of the video - for the police or the insurance. No extra program needed.

lens check - push message when the picture stays blurred and flat for 15 minutes (dew, dirt, spider web); temperature alarm (e.g. a pet in the caravan): push when it gets too hot or too cold, and when it is fine again.
